### 操作步骤
##### 一.软件安装
1)双击安装包，运行CMSServerV6安装程序，弹出选择语言的界面（简体中文/English），如下图所示：
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a980552206b96753dd5536a3e43f0413)
2)选择安装语言“简体中文”或“English”后，点击“确定”进入安装向导界面：
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=47f6c0d5572fbe2dfd7ac09bb8110356)
3) 点击“下一步”，进入选择安装路径界面，如下图所示：
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=2b93d0f318388b14588819c929d11c32)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f1f4d1a0304ee449e272c3106c98d787)
4)选择开始菜单文件夹放置位置，然后点击“下一步”继续
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=01bcd9ca81a7fb11397d725ef1ffce38)
5) 选择附加任务（是否创桌面快捷方式），然后点击“下一步”继续
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=cb2f69599ea6444ad33f98c740d81e26)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=aaa5b8bd9f4787981ad2ad857c894f2a)
6) 点击“安装”，执行程序安装操作，完成安装向导
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=3c67039915ec43cb94b339ba9d5f5a0d)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b42f63aba331f36bf217833fe4734760)
7) 单击“完成”按钮，进行相关数据配置
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8a6c256b58d0f7ba26b1b562f8a2aae1)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=099ac0865e8023ca3fb81875e8e72b4b)
8)点击“下一步”，进行网络地址配置；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d7fcb66ee50a1c5f72f49219dba86844)
9) 点击“下一步”，进行WEB服务器参数配置，四个端口选一个；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4fb2d12d666160ce0a7a86eae1bf2542)
10) 点击“下一步”，进行FTP服务器参数配置；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=eb528855493c4b944138505294eb10cb)
11) 点击“完成”，可运行CMSServerV6服务器控制器。
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a08816a5c1cb1193c9f5483d4c055a9b)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=97e1de53ccf707636e03e2821589fbca)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b0e553f653dc78309495ae54c98d2d72)

##### 二.软件卸载
卸载之前请确认已做好数据备份。
1)第一步：点击“开始”在程序里找到CMSServerV6文件夹并展开，找到卸载选项，点击“卸载”，服务器卸载时，会判断服务器是否正在运行，当服务器正在运行，卸载程序会给出提示，并请用户确认操作，点击是继续；
或者到CMSServerV6安装的根目录下找到“unins000.exe”，双击也可以执行卸载；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d2484a9f4558ffb5afffa48840205ae4)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=e8067d6f44d4f13e703fd1c499075d17)
2)第二步：卸载程序给出提示，清用户确认是否卸载软件，点击是继续；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=7d41f72d1d29773cce29b48c631bbe07)
3)第三步：开始卸载；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=1cfe5b3a2aba9ef5aadf286586f4a23b)
4)第四步：待卸载完成会给出相应提示，点击确定，完成卸载；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=dedbae79b5a8d8723bed9503d2a83882)
